title: 200 meals a week, 11 years running: the volunteers behind St. Sebastian's Meal Ministry
seoTitle: St. Sebastian Church Meal Ministry: 200 Meals a Week
description: St. Sebastian Catholic Church's Meal Ministry feeds about 200 neighbors a week. Meet the volunteers, the parish, where to get help, and its Christmas events.
dek: A parish that began with about 90 families in 1964 now feeds around 200 neighbors every week, and it has Christmas on the calendar for the whole town.
facebook: In 11 years, the Meal Ministry at St. Sebastian Catholic Church has missed one week. The volunteers feed about 200 neighbors every week. The Sebastian Porch tells their story, plus the parish's Christmas events, from Breakfast with Santa to Christmas Day.

body.text: In 11 years of cooking for their neighbors, the Meal Ministry at St. Sebastian Catholic Church has missed exactly one week.

"We at the food Ministry have the best group of volunteers," say Bob and Joanie LaPenna, who oversee the ministry. "Some have been with us for over ten years. Without this team we would not be able to feed around 200 people each week."

That one missed week stands out because every other week got done. "For the last 11 years that we have been involved there has been only 1 time that we could not get a meal out," the LaPennas say. "So we have been blessed."

The parish has its own way of describing the work: "it is thanksgiving on every Thursday." Volunteers cook hot meals and get them to neighbors who need one. Anyone can refer a neighbor by calling the parish office at 772-589-5790.

Around 200 meals a week means a lot of hands. The kitchen runs on volunteers, and the LaPennas give the credit to them. Some have been coming in for more than a decade, which is how a ministry goes 11 years and misses only once.
From 90 families to a full campus

The parish began in 1964 as St. William Mission, with about 90 families. It became St. Sebastian in 1996. Today it is St. Sebastian Catholic Community at 13075 US Highway 1, part of the Diocese of Palm Beach. When the parish marked its 25th anniversary year in 2021, the diocese counted more than 2,000 families there.

The parish is between pastors right now. Very Rev. Gavin Badway serves as administrator. Fr. Ambrose Kadambukatt is associate pastor, and so is Fr. Sabas Mallay, who works mainly at the parish's mission church, Our Lady of Guadalupe in Fellsmere.
This year the parish added something new. St. Sebastian Academy, a Catholic preschool for 3- and 4-year-olds with VPK, officially opened in August 2026.

The parish's St. Vincent de Paul Society helps neighbors with food, utility bills, clothing, furniture and prescriptions, and its thrift store pays for that work. It is at 5480 85th Street in Wabasso, phone 772-589-3338. A second St. Vincent de Paul branch serves Vero Beach. Other parish ministries visit people who are homebound or sick.

items: Need a hot meal, or know a neighbor who does? Call the parish office at 772-589-5790 and ask about the Meal Ministry.
Need help with food, a utility bill, clothing, furniture or a prescription? Call St. Vincent de Paul at 772-589-3338.
Want to help cook or deliver? Call the parish office and ask how to join the Meal Ministry volunteers.

body.text: The parish has filled December with events, and the whole neighborhood is welcome:

items: Breakfast with Santa: Sunday, Dec. 13, 8:30 to 11 a.m.
Advent Reconciliation: Tuesday, Dec. 15, 6 p.m., in the church.
Christmas Nativity Play: Saturday, Dec. 19, 5:30 p.m., in LeSage Hall.
Christmas Eve Masses: Thursday, Dec. 24, at 4, 6 and 10 p.m.
Christmas Day Masses: Friday, Dec. 25, at 9:30 and 11:30 a.m.

body.title: If you go
body.text: St. Sebastian Catholic Church, 13075 US Highway 1, Sebastian. Phone 772-589-5790. Website: stsebastian.com. Weekday Mass Monday through Saturday at 8:30 a.m.; Saturday at 4 p.m.; Sunday at 7:30, 9:30 and 11:30 a.m. Confession Saturdays at 9 a.m.
Behind every one of those 200 weekly meals is a volunteer who showed up. As the LaPennas put it: "So we have been blessed."

faq.q: Where is St. Sebastian Catholic Church?
faq.a: At 13075 US Highway 1 in Sebastian. The parish office phone is 772-589-5790.

faq.q: How can I get a meal from the St. Sebastian Meal Ministry?
faq.a: Call the parish office at 772-589-5790. Anyone can refer themselves or a neighbor in need. Volunteers serve about 200 people each week.

faq.q: Where is St. Vincent de Paul near Sebastian?
faq.a: The parish's St. Vincent de Paul Society is at 5480 85th Street in Wabasso, phone 772-589-3338. It helps with food, utility bills, clothing, furniture and prescriptions.

faq.q: What are the Christmas Mass times at St. Sebastian?
faq.a: Christmas Eve, Thursday, Dec. 24: 4, 6 and 10 p.m. Christmas Day, Friday, Dec. 25: 9:30 and 11:30 a.m.
